name: com.gameframex.unity.setting
description:
GameFrameX Setting — Unity persistent game settings package. Provides typed key-value storage (bool, int, float, string, serializable objects) over pluggable storage backends with a public ISettingStorageBackend contract and registration factory (defaulting to Unity PlayerPrefs). Mini-game storage backends ship as separate channel packages (WeChat / Douyin / Kuaishou / Alipay) installed per platform. Configuration moves to code-level SettingOptions (GameFrameXOptions.Configure, helper factory with custom reference priority); includes load/save lifecycle, existence checks and bulk removal. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Setting — Unity 持久化游戏设置功能包。提供类型化键值存储（bool、int、float、string、可序列化对象），存储后端可插拔：public 的 ISettingStorageBackend 契约与注册工厂，默认使用 Unity PlayerPrefs。小游戏存储后端以独立渠道包（微信/抖音/快手/支付宝）按平台加装。配置入口收敛为代码级 SettingOptions（GameFrameXOptions.Configure，Helper 工厂注入、自定义引用优先），提供加载/保存生命周期、存在性检查与批量删除。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
